research_scope: First-party Singapore restaurant online ordering menus, exact SFA-licence joins, up to 50 item proposals and five outlets. This scan yielded one exact outlet page with a current priced category; other branches are excluded where the page could not be proven to scope the outlet.

outlets.directory_address: 10 Eunos Road 8 #03-105, Singapore Post Centre, Singapore 408600
outlets.branch_crosswalk: Exact baseline SFA licence SE17688L000 joins to the directory row at 10 Eunos Road 8 #03-105, Singapore Post Centre, postal 408600. The first-party order page itself is headed “Carl’s Jr. SingPost Centre” and shows the same street/unit/postal address at https://order.carlsjr.com.sg/Category/premium-angus-beef-burger-combo.html. High confidence in outlet identity and displayed prices/menu labels.
outlets.page_observation: Retrieved the live first-party order page at 2026-10-19 04:52:46 SGT. The server response showed the outlet heading and address plus the Premium Angus Beef Burger (Combo) category with seven named items and SGD prices. This is a pickup/order-menu snapshot; prices and availability may change.
outlets.confidence: High for exact outlet crosswalk and page-displayed names/prices; medium for sustained availability because this is a time-sensitive online-order menu.

limitations: The order page is pickup/order scoped. Prices are not asserted as dine-in prices and may change.

Although the page lists other Carl’s Jr. outlets in its selector, testing alternate StoreID query parameters left the rendered page on SingPost Centre. No menu rows are proposed for The Star Vista or King Albert Park without a page state that actually confirms the selected branch.
The page exposes no durable menu update timestamp; observed time is the direct retrieval time.
No Mapbox or paid service was used; no workbook or Excel file was edited or generated.

evidence_sources.source_type: First-party Singapore official online ordering page
evidence_sources.evidence: Page heading identifies Carl’s Jr. SingPost Centre; displayed address is 10 Eunos Road 8 #03-105, postal 408600. The Premium Angus Beef Burger (Combo) section displays the seven item names and SGD prices in the page HTML. Direct HTTP response date header was Sun, 18 Oct 2026 20:52:46 GMT (2026-10-19 04:52:46 SGT).
evidence_sources.limitations: Dynamic ordering page; current availability and prices are subject to change.
